ActorKind.description: What kind of actor is acting (§27).

acting_role.description: §27.4 — the role ACTUALLY exercised, not the roles held.

effective_time.description:
§28.4. Recorded as supplied; server time is authoritative once KF exists
(§67.2), so a locally stamped time is provisional.

ContractCoverage.description: Which §28.5 elements a digest actually covered.

ContractElement.description:
The §28.5 elements a contract digest covers.

Recorded in the digest preimage so a partial digest is distinguishable from a
complete one (OW-ADR-0004).

ContractRevision.description:
One contract revision (§28).

Immutability is structural: there is no method that mutates an authorized
revision. `propose` and `authorize` consume `self` and return a new value.

contract_digest.description: The digest of the contract content, over `coverage`.

revision.description:
§28.1 — the Warrant identity persists across revisions; this numbers the
revision within it.

Independence.description:
Independence of an authorization from the work it authorizes (§27.4, §46).

`None` is a recorded value, never an omission. §27.4: "Role separation by one
person is not organizational independence. Human views SHALL not claim
four-eyes review when none occurred."

oneOf.description: The authorizer also produced the work. Recorded, not hidden.
A distinct identity, but the same person or organization.

RevisionState.description: Where a revision sits in §28's lifecycle.

sas_revision.description:
§14 — the SAS revision the authorized contract was compiled against.
Fixed here so that a LATER SAS revision does not move this Warrant's
contract digest out from under its signature: an authorized contract
keeps its Basis until an amendment re-authorizes it. Absent only on
records written before this field existed; those read as the latest.
